canonical_title: Owkin K Pro licensing deal with Boehringer Ingelheim
aliases: Owkin Boehringer AI drug discovery deal
treatment: Covered as a new production-scale AI drug-discovery licensing agreement. Repeat only for disclosed financial terms, validated discovery outcomes, material platform/model changes, or named clinical/development milestones.
known_facts: Boehringer Ingelheim licensed Owkin's K Pro AI research platform and patient data for oncology and immunology drug discovery.
The agreement expands a 2025 pilot; Owkin will license multimodal oncology data and generate new immunology data.
